This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Fluency, part of THE FARM – ANIMAL SAFETY AND CARE Suggested Vocabulary veterinary, poisonous, cr in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you improve your reading speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
